title: Celebrating 55 Years of the 555 Timer
summary: This post celebrates the 555 timer chip's 55th anniversary, covering its history since 1971, internal design components, and modern applications in battery protection, motion detection, and LED circuits. Not related to Dynamics 365 Business Central.
key_points: 555 timer chip designed in 1971, celebrates 55 years in 2026
Contains 23 transistors, 16 resistors, and 2 diodes for simple robust design
CMOS version used in battery protection, motion detectors, LED flashers
Remains cheap, durable, and widely integrated despite microcontroller proliferation
